integrity: Proof is analytic from effective-resistance Green kernels; rational network tests and algebraic identities are diagnostics only. No independent mathematical audit or novelty certification.
limitations: Real mean-zero arclength H1 on r equal unit parallel edges (r>=3) and one positive-length pendant at a common endpoint only. Not an assertion for unequal parallel lengths, nonuniform measures, or higher-order derivatives.
title: A sharp pendant-edge localization threshold for Sobolev evaluation on parallel-path graphs
